description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for HTTP services, providing common server setup, routing, endpoint management, and health check functionalities. It is part of the Eclipse Hono project, enabling development of HTTP-based services with support for TLS, authentication, tracing, and extensibility.

classes.name: HttpServiceBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common infrastructure for HTTP services, including server setup, routing, endpoint management, health checks, TLS configuration, authentication, and tracing support.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures a Vert.x Router with tracing, error handling, body size limits, and optional authentication. Also adds registered endpoints and custom routes.

methods.name: createTracingHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a TracingHandler for request tracing, configured with custom tags and decorators for tracing context.

methods.name: addAuthHandler
methods.description: Adds authentication handler to the router if it has been configured.

methods.name: addCustomTags
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add custom tags to tracing spans.

methods.name: addEndpointRoutes
methods.description: Registers routes for all configured HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: addCustomRoutes
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add additional custom routes before server startup.

methods.name: getHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default HTTP server options with TLS configuration, bind address, port, and maximum chunk size.

methods.name: getInsecureHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default insecure HTTP server options.

methods.name: bindSecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds the secure HTTP server to the configured port if TLS is enabled, returning a Future of HttpServer.

methods.name: bindInsecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds the insecure HTTP server to the configured port if enabled, returning a Future of HttpServer.

methods.name: startEndpoints
methods.description: Starts all registered endpoints and returns a Future for when the router is ready.

methods.name: stopEndpoints
methods.description: Stops all endpoints, returning a Future that completes once all have shut down.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Manages the sequence to start services, including pre-start, port checks, endpoints, and server binding.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Sequence to gracefully shut down servers and endpoints.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the secure HTTP server if running.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure HTTP server if running.

methods.name: preStartServers
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions before starting servers.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Hook after successful startup; can be overridden to perform post-start actions.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions before shutdown.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions after shutdown.
